description: Header file providing AVX512 helper functions for OFH compression algorithms, including max/min calculations, absolute value computations, and BFP exponent determination for resource blocks.

methods.name: find_abs_min_max_values
methods.description: Calculates the absolute min or max 16-bit sample values across resource blocks using AVX512 intrinsics, based on the comparison template parameter.

methods.name: calculate_max_abs
methods.description: Computes the maximum absolute value of IQ samples across resource blocks using AVX512.

methods.name: determine_bfp_exponent
methods.description: Determines the Block Floating Point (BFP) exponent for resource blocks based on maximum absolute values and data width.
